senses.nuances: noun 在这里涵盖专有名词。输入没有足够语境，不能指定某一位王室成员或其他人物。马来语释义为编写说明，并非 DBP 释义；下列是姓名讨论中的自然组合，未经频率验证。[姓名说明](https://snl.no/Haakon_-_mannsnamn)。

etymology.historical_story: Haakon preserves a traditional spelling associated with Norwegian naming history. Norway used Danish spelling conventions for centuries, including aa where modern Norwegian generally writes å. The Norwegian Language Council explains that historical royal names and individual name choices require attention to established spelling. The name should therefore be preserved as its bearer uses it. [Norwegian Language Council](https://sprakradet.no/spraksporsmal-og-svar/haakon-eller-hakon/).
